title: Unilever commercial story
headline: Distribution gaps — led by Shoprite — are the clearest near-term growth opportunity
subheadline: Three high-confidence distribution gaps represent R9.9k of addressable value and 211 units across priority SKU-retailer-region combinations.
key_insight: Shoprite accounts for 2 of the 3 priority actions, so listing expansion is the first commercial move rather than a price cut or extra promotional spend.
retailer_insight: SHOPRITE appears in 2 of the 3 priority actions

actions.headline: Close the 24-store distribution gap
actions.recommended_action: Close the 24-store gap toward the like-for-like benchmark at Shoprite. Expand listing of Sunlight Pine Gel 500ml across the identified Shoprite stores in Free State.

actions.headline: Close the 13-store distribution gap
actions.recommended_action: Close the 13-store gap toward the like-for-like benchmark at Shoprite. Expand listing of Sunlight Pine Gel 1l across the identified Shoprite stores in Gauteng.

actions.headline: Close the 3-store distribution gap
actions.product: Handy Andy All Purpose Cleaner Eucalyptus 5l
actions.recommended_action: Close the 3-store gap toward the like-for-like benchmark at Makro Online. Expand listing of Handy Andy All Purpose Cleaner Eucalyptus 5l across the identified Makro Online stores in Gauteng.

commercial_implication: Prioritize distribution expansion before increasing promotional spend where availability is the primary constraint.
methodology_note: Based on current POS data and identified commercial gaps. Addressable opportunity is directional and not guaranteed incremental sales.
limitations: Storytelling Engine V1 consumes Commercial Brain one-slide output only.
Specialist and Commercial Brain opportunity values are not recalculated.
Confidence is copied from the Commercial Brain and is never upgraded.
Addressable value and addressable volume are not guaranteed incremental sales.
No capture rate is introduced by the Storytelling Engine.
Dashboard and PDF layers are not built in this sprint.
Commercial Brain V1 converts frozen specialist outputs into a small set of actions. It does not re-run Data QA, Distribution, Price, or Promotion agents.
4 POS weeks currently available.
3 overlapping price/promotion weeks.
No proven normal/RSP field; off_promo_rsp / on_promo_rsp is not treated as normal shelf price.
PROMOTION_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE; the extract has no price-discount / multibuy / loyalty type.
Rolling 4 Weeks CY metrics may not be independent observations.
Promotion metrics can be missing; missing is not converted to zero.
ProductsID is not the canonical join key; SKU identity is product name.
Short price/promotion history; HIGH confidence is not manufactured.
Opportunity estimates are directional addressable values, not guaranteed incremental sales.
Distribution addressable value = value_per_store x distribution_store_gap; volume uses volume_per_store x gap.
Current sales are distinct from addressable opportunity and are never treated as incremental sales.
No causal elasticity and no causal promotion incrementality.
Specialist Distribution, Price, and Promotion agents are frozen; the Brain does not re-score them.
Overlapping levers are not summed; the reported value is the primary commercial opportunity.
Grains with at least one specialist flag: 2048.
Double-counting conflicts resolved: 279.
Dashboard, PDF, macroeconomic, and social-media layers are not built in this sprint.
